entities.summary: Igor Yevgenyevich Levitin is a Russian political figure, aide to the president of the Russian Federation since September 2013, and Class 1 active state advisor of the Russian Federation (2013). He previously served as the Minister of Transport of the Russian Federation. He is the chairman of the supervisory board of the Table Tennis Federation of Russia. He is also a member of the president advisory council at the International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF) and president of European Table Tennis Union until March 2022 when he stepped down temporarily due to the Russian invasion of Ukraine.
